description_en: Queries policies for private access applications in your Alibaba Cloud account in batches
description_zh: 批量查询当前阿里云账号下内网访问应用的策略
name: ListPolicesForPrivateAccessApplication

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the private access applications. You can specify up to 100 IDs
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问应用ID集合。最多可输入100个内网访问应用ID
parameters.name: application_ids

Applications.description_en: The list of private access applications

ApplicationId.description_en: The ID of the private access application

Policies.description_en: The collection of private access policies

ApplicationType.description_en:
The application type of the private access policy. Valid values:

Application: Application.

Tag: Tag
ApplicationType.description_zh:
内网访问策略的应用类型。取值：
Application：应用。
Tag：标签

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the private access policy was created
CreateTime.description_zh: 内网访问策略创建时间

CustomUserAttributes.description_en: The collection of custom user group attributes. If you specify multiple attributes, the relationship between them is OR
CustomUserAttributes.description_zh: 自定义用户组属性集合。多个自定义用户组属性之间是或的关系，按照合集生效

IdpId.description_en: The ID of the identity provider (IdP) for the user group. This parameter is returned when the custom user group type is department
IdpId.description_zh: 用户组的身份源ID。当自定义用户组类型为department时，存在该值

Relation.description_en:
The relationship of the user group. Valid values:

Equal: Equal to.

Unequal: Not equal to
Relation.description_zh:
用户组的关系。取值：
Equal：等于。
Unequal：不等于

UserGroupType.description_en:
The type of the user group. Valid values:

username: Username.

department: Department.

email: Email.

telephone: Mobile number
UserGroupType.description_zh:
用户组的类型。取值：
username：用户名。
department：部门。
email：邮箱。
telephone：手机

Value.description_en:
The value of the user group attribute.

If the user group type is username, this parameter specifies the value of the username. The value can be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

If the user group type is department, this parameter specifies the value of the department. Example: OU=Department 1,OU=SASE DingTalk.

If the user group type is email, this parameter specifies the value of the email address. Example: username\@example.com.

If the user group type is telephone, this parameter specifies the value of the mobile number. Example: 13900001234
Value.description_zh:
用户组属性的值。
当用户组类型为username时，表示用户名的值。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
当用户组类型为department时，表示部门的值。如：OU=部门1,OU=SASE钉钉。
当用户组类型为email时，表示邮箱的值。如：username@example.com。
当用户组类型为telephone时，表示手机的值。如：13900001234

Description.description_en: The description of the private access policy
Description.example: 这是一条内网访问策略

Name.description_en: The name of the private access policy

PolicyAction.description_en:
The action of the private access policy. Valid values:

Block: Blocks access.

Allow: Allows access
PolicyAction.description_zh:
内网访问策略动作。取值：
Block：阻断。
Allow：允许

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the private access policy

Priority.description_en: The priority of the private access policy. The value 1 indicates the highest priority
Priority.description_zh: 内网访问策略优先级。数字1表示优先级最高

Status.description_en:
The status of the private access policy. Valid values:

Enabled: The policy is enabled.

Disabled: The policy is disabled
Status.description_zh:
内网访问策略状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭

UserGroupType.description_en:
The user group type of the private access policy. Valid values:

Normal: Regular user group.

Custom: Custom user group
UserGroupType.description_zh:
内网访问策略的用户组类型。取值：
Normal：普通用户组。
Custom：自定义用户组
